description: This file defines API routes for managing notifications in a gym management system backend, including listing, marking as read, creating test notifications, and materializing reminders. It uses FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy.

classes.name: _UserContext
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the user context with user ID and role.

classes.name: MaterializeResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for the response indicating the number of notifications materialized.

methods.name: _require_user
methods.description: Dependency function that extracts and verifies the current user from JWT claims, raising HTTP 401 if unauthenticated.

methods.name: _require_trainer_or_admin
methods.description: Dependency function that ensures the current user has 'trainer' or 'admin' role, raising HTTP 403 if not.

methods.name: list_notifications
methods.description: API endpoint to list notifications for the current user with optional unread filter and pagination.

methods.name: mark_notification_read
methods.description: API endpoint to mark a specific notification as read for the current user.

methods.name: create_test_notification
methods.description: API endpoint to create a sample test notification for the current user.

methods.name: materialize_notifications
methods.description: API endpoint to trigger the materialization of due reminders into notifications, restricted to trainer or admin roles.
